key_findings: On 2026-08-08 the company beat on revenue but guided next-quarter revenue slightly below consensus.
On 2026-08-11 the company pulled forward the next-generation platform ship date by one quarter.
On 2026-08-05 three of the four largest cloud providers raised full-year capex guidance.
On 2026-08-09 a major cloud customer expanded deployment of its in-house accelerator for inference.
Data center is now roughly 87% of revenue, up from 78%, driven by AI training and inference demand.
Revenue grew 62% year over year to $211.0B, decelerating from 114% growth the prior year.
Gross margin was 74.2% and operating margin 58.1%; free cash flow was $58.9B.
The balance sheet holds $38.0B of cash against $9.7B of fixed-rate debt with no maturities before fiscal 2028.
